title: Path 1: CPU Foundations (From Package to Logic)
summary: Explore the physical layers of a microprocessor package, locate the silicon die subsystems, and trace how logic gates form an ALU.

steps.title: Inspect the Integrated Heat Spreader & Package
steps.objective: Switch to Exploded View to understand the physical assembly protecting the silicon die.

steps.title: Explore Silicon Die Floorplan Regions
steps.objective: Toggle Internal Architecture to distinguish cores, cache regions, and interconnects.

steps.title: Learn the ISA Hardware-Software Contract
steps.objective: Understand how instructions bridge software semantics and microarchitectural units.

steps.title: Examine Conceptual Digital Logic Foundations
steps.objective: Isolate enlarged CMOS transistor and adder models (explicitly marked not-to-scale).

title: Path 2: Inside an Instruction (6-Stage Lifecycle)
summary: Follow a single ADD and STORE instruction through all 6 canonical execution stages, then run full programs in the Rust/WASM simulator.

steps.title: Walk Through ADD R3, R1, R2
steps.objective: Step from FETCH to WRITE_BACK and observe MEMORY_ACCESS bypass.

steps.title: Contrast with STORE R3, 100
steps.objective: Watch MAR/MDR latch and commit data through L1d into Data Memory.

steps.title: Execute the Full 4-Line Program
steps.objective: Verify R1=10, R2=20, R3=30, MEM[100]=30 across 24 deterministic clock cycles.

steps.title: Compare Sequential Stepping vs. Pipelining
steps.objective: See how real hardware overlaps stages and resolves RAW data hazards.

title: Path 3: Memory Hierarchy & Performance Engineering
summary: Analyze why registers, L1/L2/L3 caches, branch prediction, and IPC govern processor performance beyond raw GHz.

steps.title: Split L1i/L1d & Modified Harvard
steps.objective: Understand how separating instruction and data caches prevents structural bottlenecks.

steps.title: Cache Pyramid & AMAT
steps.objective: Study temporal/spatial locality and calculate Average Memory Access Time.

steps.title: Iron Law of Processor Performance
steps.objective: Evaluate IC, CPI/IPC, and clock frequency trade-offs.

steps.title: Simulate Conditional Branching Loops
steps.objective: Run the CMP/JNZ countdown preset and inspect FLAGS.Z and cycle accumulation.

title: Path 4: Silicon Packaging, Power & Thermal Physics
summary: Connect nanoscale transistor switching power and clock distribution constraints to multi-core architectures and package thermal limits.

steps.title: Timing Closure & Critical Paths
steps.objective: Examine how combinational delay and clock skew bound f_max.

steps.title: Dynamic V^2*f Power & Leakage
steps.objective: Understand why Dennard scaling ended and why voltage scaling dominates power.

steps.title: Multi-Core CMP & Cache Coherence
steps.objective: Explore how multiple moderate-clock cores deliver higher throughput per watt.

steps.title: Thermal Resistance Stack & IHS
steps.objective: Trace heat flow from die execution units through TIM and IHS to ambient.
